dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smoothly concave trailing edge following a continuous spline from the posterior ridge to a sharp apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the terminal dorsal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly reclined anterior margin at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height is approximately 0.75 times the maximum base width at the dorsal insertion point.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-hemispherical arc with a consistent radius of curvature along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick-set beak with a pixel length roughly equal to half the vertical melon height.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse angle observed at the pixel intersection of the melon's descent and the rostrum's dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notches and serrations on the trailing edge of the visible left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Fully visible horizontal caudal fluke with a defined central notch and tapering trailing edges.
